sentences: My skin felt too dry.
Mum sent me to the shop.
We wait at the bus stop.
Papa told me about a brave chief. He led his men, and kept them safe. I wish to be brave like him.
Snow falls all week. I want to play, so I put on my warm coat. We make a big snowman out back. My toes are cold but I am glad to have fun!
My dog has soft brown ears.
The tall boy can help me.
The cold snow fell all day.
The wind woke me up. I began to hear it blow above the house. I went to check the time. It was six. I took a slow step back to bed. Soon, the sun came up, and I woke again.
I won an award this year! Mum and dad agreed I did my best, and they allowed me to buy a gift that I want. Yeah! What can a child ask for? Toys, yes, toys!
My cat has a long tail.
I wish for a new toy.
I want more cake and milk.

I wake up and wash my face. I brush my hair and put on my black shoes. I wear them on most days. Then I take my bag, and mum and I walk to the bus stop. We wait and talk. When the bus comes, I get on and find a seat.
We play chase in the yard. My dog runs after me. Then I turn and chase him. When we stop, he wags his tail. We slip on the wet path, but we are fine. We have lots of fun!
My coat keeps me so warm.
I wash my face and hands.
Yeah, we won the big game!
I carry my blocks into the room. I build a ship with them. Mum says it is true art! I once took a long time to build a ship, but now I am fast. I tell Mum to come and see.
Our class had a test on new words, and we all did well. So we put on a word show for Mum and Dad. I read my words like a star. They cheer for me at the end!
My mum makes the best cake.
We rest and eat at break time.
The soil is good for the rose.
Mum and I walk along the path. I am not alone. I spot a fat cat below a big red sign. The cat is ahead of us in the sun. I like being out with Mum.
Each April, we go to a farm. I pick red apples for Mum. We sort them by size, and the farm sells some in its shop. Mum makes an apple pie at home.
I build a home with each block.
We went to the sea last year.
I sit on the old chair made of wood.
My pet bunny is soft and brown. It hops upon my seat and sits by me. I feed it good food each day. Candy is for me, not for pets. I am sure such food is not good for my bunny.
A tiny chick lives in a nest in the tree. One day, it will fly into the wild. I sing a song to it, and it seems to like it.
The road home is very wide.
The bird flew high above me.
We play again in the park.

I bring the bowl and the tools for Mum. We begin to make the bread. An egg rolls off the top, but I catch it just in time! The bread comes out thin on one side, but it is still so good. We send some to the man next door.
As it is about to rain, our team takes a vote. We all vote to stop the game as it is not safe to play on.
The bus is just up ahead.
We go along the long road.
I agree that dogs are the best.
We went on a trip to a town in the west. Dad and I had a swim in a wide lake. Then we sat by a very tall tree near the old town wall and looked at the view. We stayed till the sun set.
I had a big board made of wood. I painted it red and built the sides. Then I put a chart on it. The class asked me to show them my work.
